plugins.name: evolvepreneuriq-console
plugins.description: Evolvepreneur®iQ Workplace (v0.4.12) — a white-label, connector-driven AI operator console. Tabs: Workflows (incl. a Business Brain lane and a Train & Improve lane that turns your edits into permanent improvements), Skills, the EIQ Connector catalogue, the EIQ persona library, and a live Dashboard tab (revenue, customers, finance & P&L, sales pipeline, subscriptions, royalties, Ops & Support, and website traffic — built connector-driven from your EIQ tenants with a consolidated Group view, monthly revenue sourced from real orders with full trading history, and per-tenant freshness stamps). Personalised per client, with dark mode, safe-by-default guardrails, an in-dashboard update check, and first-run setup for standing automations.
